description: Stores account transfer (bank/payment transfer) request header information, including the requested amount, approval workflow status, accounts confirmation, deductions and payment details.
business_purpose: Used to track account transfer requests raised by branches or users, their two-level approval (approver and accounts), confirmed and net payable amounts, hold/close status and payment date.
record_granularity: One row represents one account transfer request.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the account transfer.

columns.name: code
columns.description: Reference code of the account transfer.
columns.business_meaning: Account transfer number shown to users

columns.name: vendor_name
columns.description: Name of the vendor or payee the transfer is made to.

columns.name: message
columns.description: Free-text remark or purpose entered with the transfer request.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the account transfer was created.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the account transfer.

columns.name: branchid
columns.description: Branch the account transfer belongs to.

columns.name: creditnote_typeid
columns.description: Credit note type associated with the transfer.

columns.name: main_headId
columns.description: Main header (top-level category) the transfer is booked under.

columns.name: sub_headId
columns.description: Sub header (second-level category) under the main header.

columns.name: related_id
columns.description: Id of a related record in another section. Interpreted together with related_section; there is no database foreign key.

columns.name: related_section
columns.description: Name of the section that related_id belongs to.

columns.name: is_approved
columns.description: True when the request has been approved at the first approval level.

columns.name: is_rejected
columns.description: True when the request has been rejected at the first approval level.

columns.name: operated_byId
columns.description: User who approved or rejected the request at the first approval level.

columns.name: operated_date
columns.description: Date and time of the first-level approval or rejection.

columns.name: is_account_approved
columns.description: True when the accounts team has approved the transfer.

columns.name: is_account_rejected
columns.description: True when the accounts team has rejected the transfer.

columns.name: account_operated_byId
columns.description: Accounts user who approved or rejected the transfer.

columns.name: account_operated_date
columns.description: Date and time of the accounts approval or rejection.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount requested for the transfer.

columns.name: confirmed_amount
columns.description: Amount confirmed for the transfer. Set equal to amount when the amount is updated.

columns.name: deductions_amount
columns.description: Total amount deducted from the transfer.

columns.name: deductions
columns.description: Text description of the deductions applied.

columns.name: net_amount
columns.description: Net amount payable after deductions.

columns.name: amount_changed_byId
columns.description: User who last changed the amount.

columns.name: amount_changed_date
columns.description: Date and time when the amount was last changed.

columns.name: payment_date
columns.description: Date on which the payment was made.

columns.name: acknowledge_no
columns.description: Acknowledgement / payment reference number recorded for the transfer.

columns.name: is_closed
columns.description: True when the account transfer has been closed.

columns.name: closed_byId
columns.description: User who closed the account transfer.

columns.name: closed_date
columns.description: Date and time when the account transfer was closed.

columns.name: is_hold
columns.description: True when the transfer is on hold.

columns.name: hold_reason
columns.description: Reason the transfer was put on hold.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the record.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

columns.name: file
columns.description: Name or path of the file attached to the transfer.

columns.name: base64file
columns.description: Base64-encoded content of the attached file. Can be very large.

relationships.description: Each account transfer is created by one user.
Each account transfer belongs to one branch.
Each account transfer can be linked to one credit note type.
Each account transfer can be booked under one main header.
Each account transfer can be booked under one sub header, which itself belongs to a main header.
First-level approver or rejecter of the transfer.
Accounts user who approved or rejected the transfer.
User who last changed the amount.
User who last modified the record.
Users explicitly associated with a transfer. Join with SectionUsers.related_section = 'AccountTransfer'. Not a database foreign key.
Chat messages on a transfer. Join with ERP_ChatEngine.related_section = 'AccountTransfer'. Not a database foreign key.
Files uploaded against a transfer. Join with ComplaintsFile.related_section = 'AccountTransfer'. Not a database foreign key.

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should always be excluded from reporting.
Approval is two-level: is_approved / is_rejected (operated_by) is the first level, is_account_approved / is_account_rejected (account_operated_by) is the accounts level.
confirmed_amount is the accounts-confirmed value; amount is the originally requested value. When the amount is updated, confirmed_amount is set to the same value.
net_amount is the amount payable after deductions_amount; deductions holds the textual description of the deductions.
A transfer with is_hold = 1 is on hold and should not be treated as paid; hold_reason explains why.
A transfer with is_closed = 1 is closed; closed_by and closed_date record who closed it and when.
payment_date is the date the payment was made and is only populated once a transfer has been paid.
created_date is used for request-period reporting.
Row-level visibility: non-admin users can only see transfers they created or are explicitly associated with through SectionUsers (related_section = 'AccountTransfer').

known_issues: Amount columns are stored as float, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
amount, confirmed_amount, deductions_amount and net_amount are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
sub_headId is not enforced at the database level to belong to main_headId, so the two can be inconsistent.

query_notes: The database is MySQL; use MySQL syntax and the table name AccountTransfer.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting transfers. Do not count rows as transfers if joins to SectionUsers, ERP_ChatEngine or ComplaintsFile may duplicate records.
Use SUM(confirmed_amount) for total transfer value, SUM(net_amount) for amount payable after deductions, and SUM(amount) only when the requested amount is asked for.

Foreign key columns are named created_byId, operated_byId, account_operated_byId, closed_byId, amount_changed_byId, modified_byId, branchid, creditnote_typeid, main_headId and sub_headId (note the mixed casing). Join to Users.Id, Branch.id, CMS_CreditNoteTypes.id, AccountTransferMainHeader.Id and AccountTransferSubHeader.Id to resolve names.
For resolved names (main header, sub header, closed by, operated by) and approval_status, prefer the AccountTransferView model instead of joining manually.
When joining to SectionUsers, ERP_ChatEngine or ComplaintsFile, always add related_section = 'AccountTransfer'.
Never select base64file; it can hold very large file contents.
